user.title: Add an Airversa Scenta diffuser

data_description.keepalive_seconds: How often the keepalive frame is sent over the open BLE link. Lower this if the session ever times out.
data_description.pin: PIN used at login. Factory default is 8888; change it only if you set a different one in the Sleekpoint app.
data_description.sync_state: After login, send the clock so the diffuser reports power, sound, mode and schedules. Turn off to fall back to command-only behaviour.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Write one native schedule slot on the diffuser. Fields left out keep the value the device last reported.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start time. Same start and end means all day.

mist.name: Mist time
mist.description: Seconds of mist per cycle. Use with pause; replaces intensity.

pause.name: Pause time
pause.description: Seconds between mists. ANP allows 60 to 3600 (75 minimum when mist is 15 s or longer).

intensity.name: Intensity
intensity.description: Preset level instead of custom mist and pause.
